heading: ## Pin disposition and provenance correction — round 13

findings.quote: | Recorded target bytes equal the current worktree | Report `unchanged` content |
findings.why: At C0 `unchanged` also requires the pin to verify against the manifest digest (`tools/pin-disposition.py:67-71`, `:563-567`), so a readable worktree whose bytes equal the recorded target is reported `unavailable`/`pin_not_verified` when the manifest digest disagrees — the tool's own `pinned-blob-mismatch` selftest asserts exactly that state (`:1157-1179`) — while this row's unqualified Observation→Decision pair would report `unchanged`.
